text_block_list.text:
During training, Daiwa Scarlet got 
injured, so I quickly took her to the 
nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "...Um, thanks for taking care of me."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
But I'm fine now. It'd be a waste of time 
to just stay in bed.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
All the more reason if you're aiming for 
"number one." You need to train even 
harder—
choice_data_list:
...Let's make sure you fully recover so 
you can take first place.

With that spirit, you'll get better in no 
time!

With that spirit, you'll get better in no 
time!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
All the more reason if you're aiming for 
"number one." You need to train even 
harder—
choice_data_list:
...Let's make sure you fully recover so 
you can take first place.

With that spirit, you'll get better in no 
time!

With that spirit, you'll get better in no 
time!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Don't worry over nothing. The injured 
person herself says she's fine, doesn't 
she?
choice_data_list:
If you can't give it your all, there's no 
point in practicing

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...That's...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. There's no point in 
exercising when you can barely apply any 
load.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...*Sigh*. I'm such an idiot...

That day, to be on the safe side, I 
decided to let Daiwa Scarlet rest.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes! Look at you, you understand 
quite well yourself.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, we're resuming training right 
this instant!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"I already know I'm being a bit reckless. 
Don't go getting soft on me now."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Come on, hurry—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Kyah...-!?

"She tried to shake off the restraint and 
resume training, but she ended up 
collapsing again, requiring several days 
of rest as a result..."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's decided, let's just focus 
on getting that injury healed up quickly.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
First, cool down the affected area—... 
wait.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...What's with that look? I didn't say 
anything weird, did I?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So I can train for every minute and every 
second. If I'm aiming to be "Number One," 
I need to make sure I take proper care of 
any injuries, too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, it's not just 'impressive'. It's 
'just as expected of Daiwa Scarlet', isn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm an Umamusume who's destined to be 
number one!

Later on, Daiwa Scarlet safely resumed her 
training.
